title: Gordon College (Gordon)
summary: Gordon College (Gordon) is a university in Wenham. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with Gordon.

sections.heading: What Gordon is known for
paragraphs: Gordon College is a private nonprofit institution known for its diverse academic offerings and moderate admission selectivity. With an undergraduate enrollment of 1,278 students, the college maintains an admission rate of approximately 69.2%, reflecting its accessible admissions process. Gordon places a notable emphasis on business education, with nearly 19.6% of its programs dedicated to this field, making it a significant area of study for its student body. Additionally, health-related programs constitute about 1.58% of the academic offerings, indicating a smaller but present focus on health disciplines. These characteristics highlight Gordon's commitment to providing a range of educational opportunities within a private nonprofit framework.
